machines.name: Superstructure · operating modes

states.name: Idle
states.description: Neutral outputs; disabled always resolves here and clears all old demands.

states.name: Intake
states.description: Rollers at 8 V. Hood clears the slide, then the slide runs its intake sequence.

states.name: Shoot
states.description: Shooter spins for the hub (or corner feed); indexer and feeder run once the flywheel is at speed.

states.name: Rev
states.description: Pre-spin shooter and aim hood for the current target; feed is inhibited. Never overrides a shot intent.

states.name: Rev And Intake
states.description: Revving while intaking; slide to ground intake.

states.name: Shoot And Intake
states.description: Shooting and intaking together; slide to ground intake.

states.name: Jitter
states.description: Rollers on and the slide jitters to unjam pieces.

states.name: Home
states.description: Stop rollers, flywheel and feed; clear the hood before moving the slide to ground intake. No timeout bypass of clearance.

states.name: Cancel All
states.description: Stop all powered mechanism commands. Latched until a new valid operator or autonomous request.

inputs.name: Finite robot pose and shot solution
Manual rev or eligible alliance zone
Slide clear for the requested operation

machines.description: Intent-driven supervisor. Stop/fault > home > outtake > shoot+jitter > shoot+intake > shoot > jitter > rev+intake > intake > rev > idle. Zones only request rev when no shot is requested. Disabled clears intent. Physical readiness gates the feeder continuously.

states.name: Raise hood clear of the slide
Spin flywheel to the requested speed
Feed; latched until the shot request ends
Paused under the trench (hood forced down)

rules.title: Battery sagging for 2 s
rules.detail: Battery stayed under 11.5 V for two seconds. Swap or charge before the next match.

rules.title: Robot browned out
rules.detail: The roboRIO reported a brownout. Check what was drawing current in the seconds before.

source.converted: Pose anchors from the legacy paths; existing marker bindings and mechanism behavior preserved. Executed by vendored Mayhem C++ suite runtime.
source.stateRedesign: Intent-driven Mayhem supervisor, continuous shot/hood/slide/aim/trench interlocks, clean cancellation, explicit auto phase intent. Supersedes legacy zone and missing second-sweep marker behavior.
source.markerWarningsResolved: Legacy missing intake2/idle2 bindings replaced with explicit progress markers for each collection and stage-end. All marker actions now use exact autonomous intent.
